text: Hello! How can I get started with Curify?
response: Welcome to Curify AI Advisor! I'm here to help you with product info, orders, pricing, and AI-powered insights. How can I assist you today?

text: Hi there! What does Curify do?
response: Hi! Curify is an AI-powered advisory platform that helps you make smarter decisions. What would you like to know?

text: Vanakkam! Curify pathi sollunga.
response: Vanakkam! Curify AI Advisor ungalukku sarvīs pathi theriyappadutha idhu irukku. Edhuvum kēlungal!

text: Good morning! I need some help.
response: Good morning! Absolutely, I'm here to help. What can I assist you with today?

text: Hey! Is anyone there?
response: Hey! Yes, Curify AI Advisor is here 24/7 to assist you. What do you need help with?

text: What products does Curify offer?
response: Curify offers three main products: (1) AI Advisor — personalized recommendations, (2) Analytics Dashboard — real-time insights, and (3) AutoReport — automated report generation. Would you like details on any?

text: Tell me about the AI Advisor feature.
response: The AI Advisor uses machine learning to analyse your data and provide actionable recommendations. It integrates with your existing tools via API. Shall I walk you through the setup?

text: Curify la enna features irukku?
response: Curify-la mukkiya features: AI Advisor, Smart Analytics, AutoReport, and API integrations. Edhil unakku interest irukku?

text: Does Curify integrate with Google Sheets?
response: Yes! Curify integrates with Google Sheets, Excel, Notion, and popular CRMs via our REST API. Setup takes under 5 minutes. Want the integration guide?

text: What industries does Curify support?
response: Curify supports retail, healthcare, finance, logistics, and education sectors. Our AI models are pre-trained for each vertical. Which industry are you in?

text: How much does Curify cost?
response: Curify has three plans: Starter (₹999/mo), Growth (₹2,999/mo), and Enterprise (custom). Annual billing saves 20%. Which plan fits your needs?

text: Is there a free trial available?
response: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to the Growth plan features — no credit card required. Sign up at curify.ai/trial.

text: Curify ka price kya hai?
response: Curify ke plans hain: Starter ₹999/month, Growth ₹2,999/month, Enterprise custom pricing. Annual plan pe 20% discount milta hai!

text: What's included in the Enterprise plan?
response: The Enterprise plan includes unlimited users, custom AI model training, dedicated support, SLA guarantee, and on-premise deployment options. Contact sales@curify.ai for a quote.

text: Naan student aana discount kidaikkuma?
response: Students agave special 50% discount provide pannrom! Educational email (.edu or .ac.in) la register pannunga. Discount automatic-a apply aagum.

text: Where is my order? I placed it 3 days ago.
response: I can check that for you! Please share your Order ID and I'll fetch the latest status right away.

text: My subscription hasn't been activated yet.
response: I'm sorry for the delay! Please share your registered email and Order ID. Typical activation takes 2–4 hours. I'll escalate this for you.

text: Order #12345 status check panna.
response: Order #12345 pathi check panren. Usually dashboard la 'My Orders' section la real-time status kaanaalam. Order ID share pannunga, naan verify panren.

text: I paid but didn't receive the confirmation email.
response: Payment received but no confirmation? Don't worry — please check your spam folder first. If not there, share your transaction ID and I'll resend the confirmation.

text: When will my plan renewal happen?
response: Your plan auto-renews on the billing anniversary date. You can check the exact date in Settings → Billing. Need me to help you find it?

text: The AI Advisor is giving wrong recommendations.
response: I sincerely apologise for this experience! Wrong recommendations are unacceptable. Please describe the specific issue with a screenshot if possible. I'm raising a high-priority ticket for our ML team.

text: Your dashboard keeps crashing on my browser.
response: So sorry about that! Browser crashes shouldn't happen. Please tell me your browser version and OS. Meanwhile, try clearing cache or using Chrome/Firefox. I'll file a bug report immediately.

text: Curify app la bug irukku
response: complaint
column4: Sorry for the trouble! Bug report-a immediately ML team-kku escalate pannrom. Screen recording or screenshot irundha attach pannunga. Fix 24–48 hrs la varum.

text: I've been waiting 5 days for a response from support.
response: That's completely unacceptable — I sincerely apologise. I'm escalating your case to our Head of Support right now and marking it URGENT. You'll receive a call within 2 hours.

text: The API integration is broken and costing us money.
response: I understand the urgency — a broken API integration is critical. I'm immediately connecting you with our senior technical team. Please share your API endpoint and error logs.

text: I want a refund for my subscription.
response: I understand. Refund requests are processed within 5–7 business days. You're eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Shall I initiate the process? I'll need your Order ID.

text: How do I cancel my plan and get money back?
response: You can cancel anytime from Settings → Billing → Cancel Plan. If within 30 days, you'll receive a pro-rated refund. Want me to walk you through the cancellation steps?

text: Paisa wapas chahiye
response: refund_request
column4: Bilkul! Refund 30 din ke andar possible hai. Aapka Order ID share karein — main refund process shuru kar deta hoon. 5–7 business days mein process hoga.

text: My card was charged twice. I need a refund.
response: Double-charging is a serious issue — I sincerely apologise! I'm flagging this as urgent to our billing team. Please share your bank statement screenshot and registered email for fastest resolution.

text: Refund process eppadi panna?
response: Refund process simple: Settings → Billing → 'Request Refund' click pannunga. 30 days within irundha eligible. Order ID share pannunga, naan help panren.

text: What AI tools does Curify recommend for my business?
response: Great question! Based on typical business needs, Curify recommends starting with our AI Advisor for demand forecasting and our Analytics Dashboard for KPI tracking. What's your primary business goal?

text: How can AI help improve my sales?
response: AI can boost sales by predicting customer churn, personalising offers, and optimising pricing. Curify's AI Advisor does all three. Want me to show you a demo scenario?

text: AI use panni business profit increase pannalam?
response: Definitely! AI-a use panni: customer behavior predict pannalam, personalized offers kudukkalaam, inventory optimize pannalam. Curify Advisor unakku specific recommendations tharum. Business type sollunga!

text: What machine learning models does Curify use?
response: Curify uses a combination of LightGBM for classification, LSTM for time-series forecasting, and transformer-based NLP for text analytics. All models are fine-tuned on your domain data.

text: Can Curify predict customer churn?
response: Yes! Our churn prediction model achieves 89% accuracy on average. It analyses purchase frequency, support tickets, and engagement scores to flag at-risk customers 30 days in advance.

text: I can't log in to my account.
response: I'm sorry you're locked out! Please try: (1) Reset password via 'Forgot Password', (2) Check if caps lock is on. If still stuck, share your registered email and I'll manually verify your account.

text: My password reset email is not coming.
response: Password reset emails sometimes land in spam — please check there first. Still not there? I'll manually trigger a reset link to your registered email. What's your email address?

text: Account delete panna mudiyuma?
response: Account delete pannanum na Settings → Profile → Delete Account la request pannalaam. Oru confirmation email varum. Note: All data permanently deleted. Backup download panna oru option irukku.

text: I need to update my billing email address.
response: To update your billing email: Settings → Billing → Edit Email. If you encounter issues, share your current and new email and I'll update it manually on our end.

text: My two-factor authentication is not working.
response: 2FA issues can be tricky! Try: (1) Sync your authenticator app time, (2) Use a backup code from your saved list. Still stuck? I'll disable 2FA temporarily so you can regain access.

text: Bye! Thanks for the help.
response: You're welcome! Thank you for choosing Curify AI Advisor. Have a wonderful day! 😊 Feel free to return anytime.

text: Goodbye! That was very helpful.
response: So glad I could help! Goodbye! Remember, Curify support is available 24/7 whenever you need us. Take care! 🙏

text: Thanks
response: general_farewell
column4: Absolutely! Talk later. Your issue has been noted and our team will follow up if needed. Stay awesome! 👋

text: Nandri! Mela pesalam.
response: Nandri! Ungalukku help panna mudindhadhu santhosham. Yeppodhum vaanga, Curify always ready! 🌟

text: Ok that's all I needed. Thank you!
response: Happy to help! All the best. If you think of more questions later, just ping us — we're always here. Bye for now! 😊

text: I want to talk to a real person.
response: Of course! Connecting you to a live support agent now. Please hold for approximately 2–3 minutes. Your conversation history has been shared with the agent for context.

text: Can I speak with a human agent please?
response: Absolutely! I'm transferring you to our human support team. They're available Mon–Sat, 9 AM–7 PM IST. Current estimated wait time: ~3 minutes.

text: Manushya se baat karni hai.
response: Zaroor! Aapko abhi ek live agent se connect kar raha hoon. Wait time approximately 2–3 minutes hai. Aapka conversation history agent ko share kar diya gaya hai.

text: Enna chatbot pesaraan
response: escalate_human
column4: Sorry for the inconvenience! Unakku oru human support agent-a connect pannren. Wait time: 2–3 minutes. Neengal pesina vishayam-ellaam agent-kitta already share pannirukken.

text: This bot can't solve my problem. Get me a manager.
response: I understand your frustration and I sincerely apologise. I'm escalating this directly to a senior support manager now. They will contact you within 1 hour via your registered email or phone.
